name: Trelane's Orb
summary: In the ogre-held tower in Arathi Highlands, Trelane’s Orb is one of three objects Skuerto asks you to recover. It is kept in a chest alongside Trelane’s Phylactery and Trelane’s Ember Agate.

sections.title: The Tower Chest
sections.body: Skuerto at Refuge Pointe sends you to the tower in Arathi Highlands for Trelane’s Orb and two other objects. The orb is kept in a chest within the tower. Ogres guard the place, so Skuerto warns you to be ready if they discover you among their chests.

faq.answer: Trelane’s Orb is in a chest inside the tower in Arathi Highlands.

aliases: who do i take it to
faq.answer: Skuerto at Refuge Pointe asks you to recover Trelane’s Orb and bring it back.

faq.q: What else is in the tower?
faq.answer: Trelane’s Phylactery and Trelane’s Ember Agate are also kept in chests within the tower.
Ogres guard the tower in Arathi Highlands.
